feeds.description: Two busy moms who share their passion for travel. Who's the wit behind the blog? Well, Anjali's idea of sharing her life experiences (mostly travel)with the world gave birth to this little cozy place named Travel Melodies. Then Neha joined in and both discovered the joy of traveling and writing together. And Travel Melodies was reborn!

feeds.title: Travelling Sunglasses » Hungary
feeds.description: Travel is our biggest passion: it makes us feel alive, curious, engaged with the world! We have full-time jobs which allow us to spend almost all of our paid time off travelling the world. We always crave a European city break, we had amazing experiences in Japan and Australia, and we happily spend time in my hometown of Cortina d'Ampezzo, Italy. We love cultural experiences and architectural landmarks; we follow our nose to exciting culinary discoveries; we recharge with easy hikes in nature.
